title: Framework auth parity: all 17 credential methods wired in Configure()
essence: Before this change, the pure-framework provider's Configure() only handled PAT credentials — every non-PAT caller (CLI, MSI, OIDC, client-secret) received a nil ResourceData, silently breaking all 68 resources. This initiative ports the full credential-resolution logic into a framework-native path, adds a fail-fast diagnostic on zero-credential configs, closes a security gap (explicit use_cli=false now honoured vs silently overridden to true), declares protocol 6.0, and bumps the provider to v2.0.1.
